title: Super Sushi
body:
This mod add 10 diffrent types of sushi, all of them give effect to the eater. All effects last 10 minutes.

All crafting recipes in gallery


Salmon Sushi: gives speed II

Avocado Sushi: gives saturation

Chorus Sushi: tps player 15 blocks in the air

Copper Sushi: gives invisibility

Redstone Sushi: give 10 golden hearts

Lapis Lazuli: gives haste III

Iron Sushi: gives resistance

Golden Sushi: gives four hearts

Diamond Sushi: give strength II

Netherite Sushi: gives resistance V
